Judging.title: Judge dashboard
Judging.description: Review assigned projects, apply the rubric, and give teams thoughtful feedback.
Judging.organizerDescription: Set the judging rubric, assign submitted projects, and publish completed results.
Judging.empty: No projects assigned yet. Your organizer will assign submitted projects here.
Judging.notFound: This project is unavailable or is not assigned to you.
Judging.progressHelp: Only finalized evaluations count toward completed progress.
Judging.guidelinesText: Review the submitted project and its resources. Score each criterion from 1 to 10. Save a draft while reviewing, then finalize with clear, constructive feedback. You can access only your own assigned evaluations.
Judging.rubricHelp: Weights total 100%. Rubric versions are permanent. The round uses one rubric so all teams are scored consistently.
Judging.unpublished: Results have not been published. Your organizer will release the leaderboard after judging is complete.
Judging.published: Results are published. The scoring round is locked.
Judging.snapshotHelp: You are reviewing the saved submission version from the assignment. Later edits by the team do not change this copy.
Judging.scoringHelp: Use whole numbers from 1 to 10. The weighted total is out of 100.
Judging.finalizedHelp: Evaluation finalized and saved. This evaluation is now read only.
Judging.finalWarning: Finalizing locks your scores and feedback. Check them before submitting.
Judging.evaluations: {count, plural, one {# completed evaluation} other {# completed evaluations}}
Judging.assignmentHelp: Assign an active judge to a submitted project. Each team’s judges evaluate the same saved version. Judges cannot evaluate their own teams.
Judging.publicationHelp: Results can be published after the submission deadline. Every submitted team needs an evaluation, and all assignments must be finalized. Published results freeze the round. Unpublish to add assignments.
Judging.emptyAssignments: No assignments yet. Create a rubric and assign a submitted team to a judge.
Judging.previewHelp: Only finalized evaluations are averaged. Draft scores are excluded. Equal totals share a rank. This preview stays private until publication.
